1: ## 1. Create LoadMemoryContext Action
2: 
3: - [ ] 1.1 Create `lib/goodwizard/actions/memory/load_context.ex` with `LoadMemoryContext` action module using `Jido.Action` with schema params: `topic` (string, default ""), `max_episodes` (integer, default 5), `max_procedures` (integer, default 3)
4: - [ ] 1.2 Implement recent episode loading: always load the 3 most recent episodes via `Memory.Episodic.list/2`
5: - [ ] 1.3 Implement topic-relevant episode loading: when `topic` is non-empty, search for additional episodes via `Memory.Episodic.search/3` and merge with recent episodes
6: - [ ] 1.4 Implement episode deduplication by ID and cap at `max_episodes`
7: - [ ] 1.5 Implement procedure loading: when `topic` is non-empty, use `Memory.Procedural.recall/3`; otherwise fall back to `Memory.Procedural.list/2` ordered by confidence/usage
8: - [ ] 1.6 Cap procedures at `max_procedures`
9: 
10: ## 2. Format Memory Context
11: 
12: - [ ] 2.1 Implement `format_memory_context/2` that combines episodes and procedures into a markdown string with "Relevant Past Experiences" and "Relevant Procedures" sections
13: - [ ] 2.2 Implement `format_episodes/1` that renders each episode as a compact block: timestamp, type, outcome, summary, and key lesson (from body)
14: - [ ] 2.3 Implement `format_procedures/1` that renders each procedure as a compact block: summary, confidence level, and when-to-apply trigger
15: - [ ] 2.4 Handle empty lists gracefully (omit section entirely if no episodes or no procedures)
16: 
17: ## 3. Integrate into Channel Handlers
18: 
19: - [ ] 3.1 Add memory context loading in `lib/goodwizard/channels/cli.ex` on first message of a new session: call `LoadMemoryContext` action with the first user message as `topic`, append result to system prompt
20: - [ ] 3.2 Add memory context loading in `lib/goodwizard/channels/telegram.ex` on first message of a new session: same integration as CLI
21: - [ ] 3.3 Add graceful error handling in both handlers: if `LoadMemoryContext` fails, log a debug warning and proceed without memory context
22: 
23: ## 4. Register Action
24: 
25: - [ ] 4.1 Add `Goodwizard.Actions.Memory.LoadContext` to the agent's tool list in `lib/goodwizard/plugins/tools.ex` (the agent may also call this explicitly mid-conversation)
26: 
27: ## 5. Tests
28: 
29: - [ ] 5.1 Add test: `LoadMemoryContext` returns formatted context with recent episodes when no topic is provided
30: - [ ] 5.2 Add test: `LoadMemoryContext` returns topic-relevant episodes when topic is provided
31: - [ ] 5.3 Add test: episodes are deduplicated by ID when recent and topic-relevant sets overlap
32: - [ ] 5.4 Add test: total episodes are capped at `max_episodes`
33: - [ ] 5.5 Add test: procedures are loaded via recall when topic is provided
34: - [ ] 5.6 Add test: procedures fall back to list when no topic is provided
35: - [ ] 5.7 Add test: procedures are capped at `max_procedures`
36: - [ ] 5.8 Add test: empty episodic store returns context without the episodes section
37: - [ ] 5.9 Add test: empty procedural store returns context without the procedures section
38: - [ ] 5.10 Add test: both stores empty returns empty context string
39: - [ ] 5.11 Add test: formatted context uses markdown with readable episode summaries
40: - [ ] 5.12 Add test: formatted context uses markdown with readable procedure summaries

1: defmodule Goodwizard.Channels.CLI.Server do
2:   @moduledoc """
3:   CLI REPL channel server.
4: 
5:   A GenServer that manages a CLI REPL session — creates a Messaging room,
6:   starts an AgentServer, and runs a blocking IO loop in a linked Task.
7: 
8:   ## Process lifecycle
9: 
10:   The REPL IO loop runs in a Task linked to this GenServer. When the user
11:   sends EOF (Ctrl-D), the task exits normally, which terminates this server
12:   via the link. The `mix goodwizard.cli` task monitors this server and exits
13:   when it goes down. This is the intended shutdown path.
14:   """
15:   use GenServer
16: 
17:   require Logger
18: 
19:   alias Goodwizard.Agent, as: GoodwizardAgent
20:   alias Goodwizard.Messaging
21: 
22:   @ask_timeout 120_000
23:   @max_input_length 10_000
24:   @user_sender_id "user"
25:   @assistant_sender_id "assistant"
26: 
27:   @doc "Starts the CLI server and links to the calling process."
28:   @spec start_link(keyword()) :: GenServer.on_start()
29:   def start_link(opts \\ []) do
30:     GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts)
31:   end
32: 
33:   if Mix.env() == :test do
34:     @doc false
35:     def get_state(pid), do: GenServer.call(pid, :get_state)
36:   end
37: 
38:   @doc false
39:   def send_input(pid, input), do: GenServer.call(pid, {:input, input}, @ask_timeout + 5_000)
40: 
41:   @impl true
42:   def init(opts) do
43:     Logger.info("CLI channel starting", channel: :cli)
44:     workspace = Keyword.get(opts, :workspace, Goodwizard.Config.workspace())
45: 
46:     # Create or retrieve the CLI messaging room
47:     {:ok, room} =
48:       Messaging.get_or_create_room_by_external_binding(:cli, "goodwizard", "direct", %{
49:         type: :direct,
50:         name: "CLI"
51:       })
52: 
53:     # Start the agent
54:     case start_cli_agent(workspace) do
55:       {:ok, agent_pid} ->
56:         Logger.info("CLI channel started, room=#{room.id}", channel: :cli)
57:         Task.start(fn -> Goodwizard.Plugins.Session.cleanup_old_sessions() end)
58: 
59:         state = %{room_id: room.id, agent_pid: agent_pid, workspace: workspace}
60:         maybe_start_repl(opts, state)
61: 
62:         {:ok, state}
63: 
64:       {:error, reason} ->
65:         Logger.error("Failed to start agent: #{inspect(reason)}", channel: :cli)
66:         {:stop, reason}
67:     end
68:   end
69: 
70:   if Mix.env() == :test do
71:     @impl true
72:     def handle_call(:get_state, _from, state) do
73:       {:reply, state, state}
74:     end
75:   end
